content: {"phoneNote":"Phone works as a solid stack with a real workshop photo up front, but the lower half thins out into text-only sections, a dangling 'Savinjska regija' line and a footer that repeats the contact block.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is well balanced, yet the grey 'Po nesreči' band has a dead gap above the image, the tow section is a near-empty strip of text, and the dark CTA ends in two weak underlined links.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Fold the dark 'Potrebujete vleko' CTA and the footer contact block into one, with a single filled call button, so phone and address appear once below the hero instead of three times.","Give the 'Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji' section real content (service-area map or tow-truck photo) and drop the orphaned 'Savinjska regija' line.","On desktop align the AI image to the top of the grey section to remove the dead band, and make the CTA links proper buttons matching the hero's amber style."],"blockers":[]}
